title: Parse Uncertain Amounts
prompt: Create a function that accepts nullable text, safely parses a positive amount, and returns null when the input is absent, non-numeric, zero, or negative.
successCriteria: No not-null assertion or throwing numeric conversion is used.
Parsing and positive-value validation are both performed.
The caller handles success and absence explicitly.
hints: A safe-call chain can trim and parse present text.
Validate the parsed Double before returning it.
solutionOutline: Safely normalise and parse the nullable input.
Call the function with valid and invalid examples.
verification: Try null, blank, text, zero, negative, and positive values.
Confirm that none of the invalid examples throws.
